class_to_ultra_nearest_distance.interpretation: Every CLASS crossing has a nearby ultra candidate, but ultra contains many additional crossings; nearest-neighbor proximity is not equality of complete phase sequences.

interpretation: Accuracy and phase sampling are not converged. Ultra cannot be called a converged best estimate, and its extreme ratio cannot support a physical exclusion. The three levels also change multiple numerical knobs, so single-variable experiments are required before attribution to a specific setting.
verification: Independent reconstruction verified all six level/model outputs, crossing counts and positions, CLASS-to-level nearest distances, and highest bands for 5 sources and 3 methods.
boundaries: No observational likelihood, covariance, joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, or model-family exclusion.
Additional crossings may include newly resolved structure; they are not automatically labeled numerical noise.
The next experiment must vary one numerical setting at a time with unchanged physical inputs.
